name: copilotprompts-copilot-studio-it-helpdesk-triage-agent
title: IT Helpdesk Triage Agent
shortDescription: Copilot Studio agent that guides employees through self-service IT troubleshooting by device type and issue, escalating with a ticket summary if unresolved.
longDescription: This Copilot Studio prompt generates an IT helpdesk agent that uses progressive triage: device type selection, issue category selection, three guided troubleshooting steps with per-step resolution checks, and automatic ticket creation with employee details if unresolved. Integrates with Power Automate for ticket creation in ServiceNow, Dataverse, or SharePoint.

metadata.value: Create an agent that helps employees troubleshoot common IT issues by device type and issue category, with three troubleshooting steps and ticket escalation.
